title: making friends when I love to be alone - how I find connection
en: foreign I spend a lot of time alone I've been this way since I was a child I wanted to be many things when I grew up and one of them was a biologist because I enjoyed spending time out in nature observing the wild world what I didn't know was that no matter where life took me I could still live that dream in my own small way nearly each day whether permitting I go out with my dog Iger and spend time waiting and watching for the beauty hidden in plain sight
foreign I never feel so whole and so surrounded

by life and connection as I do when I'm out in nature when I think of friendship I think of the creatures that coexist in my world my favorite Willow and oak tree that I planted by my home these are friends though not in your typical way I've always sustained unconventional friendships and to be honest I never thought this was odd until I got older and felt obligated to fit in I made a

video a couple months ago about how I struggled to make human friends for a long time it took a while to get older and slowly build lasting friendships with lovely Kindred Spirits but I'll never be someone with a large amount of relationships in my life at least not human ones I remember a teacher once called me a Hermit for wanting to sit in a quiet place instead of going to recess she took away my book and told me to act normal I do think that in this day and age when we're so connected with each other than ever we forget that it is completely normal and okay to not have

an amazing exciting bustling life or social life for that matter perhaps we should take time to understand and accept who we are our true nature and find Value in the amount of energy we have even if it falls short of what we think we'd like to be I never felt so at peace until I really listened and I hope you follow where that inner truth takes you whether you are a very social person or not so much and find ways to give and to support others in your own unique way foreign

I found several leaves and some pieces of bark and lichen at the lake today and so I took them home to kind of take a closer look and study them under my magnifying glass and make a amateur attempt to categorize them and write down my observations and it's so much fun I feel like even though I did not pursue a career in the Life Sciences I can still have fun and really enjoy learning about that aspect of life at the end of the day my more artistic sensibilities took over and pushed me in

a different direction but I do think it is so important to really consider those unlived lives and find ways to incorporate aspects of that into your daily life I think it makes a life experience so much richer this is a short but hopefully sweet video this week I had quite a few things going on and so going out to the lake and having a quiet day creating art and all that was so special to me and it inspired kind of revisiting that theme of friendships I was so moved and initially surprised by how many people related to the video and have felt how I have felt when I was younger and it was a very very moving it was so lovely to have conversations with people and open that

conversation of what does it mean to have close friendships is something wrong with me if I'm not a super social person I also place a lot of value and connection and friendship with things that are not particularly human in origin I also value time in nature because I find it to be a really self-reflective environment where I can become more of my own friend there are several people in my life and my family as well that are so close to me and represent such important bonds of kindred spirit and I really value those people to find Spirits you really connect with and I am also feel very very lucky that I have that in my husband as well sending so much love to all of you thank you for all your kindness and your support and I will see you soon
zh: 外国 我花了很多时间独自一人 我从小就是这样 长大后我想做很多事，其中之一是生物学家，因为我喜欢花时间在大自然中观察野生世界 但我不知道的是，无论生活把我带到哪里，我几乎每天都可以以自己的方式实现这个梦想，只要允许我和我的狗艾格一起出去，花时间等待和观察隐藏在平淡视野中的美丽
异国他乡，我从未感到如此完整和如此被包围
当我在大自然中时，当我想到友谊时，我会想到在我的世界里共存的生物，我最喜欢的柳树和我在家里种植的橡树，这些都是朋友，尽管不是以你典型的方式，我一直保持着非传统的友谊，说实话，我从来没有觉得这很奇怪，直到我长大了，觉得有义务融入其中，我做了一个
几个月前的视频，讲述了我如何努力结交人类朋友很长一段时间，花了一段时间才变老，慢慢地与可爱的志趣相投的人建立持久的友谊，但我永远不会成为一个在我的生活中拥有大量人际关系的人，至少不会是人类。我记得一位老师曾经称我为隐士，因为我想坐在一个安静的地方而不是去休息，她拿走了我的书，告诉我要表现得正常，我确实认为在这个时代，当我们彼此联系如此紧密时，我们忘记了它完全正常，没有也没关系
令人惊叹的、令人兴奋的忙碌生活或社交生活，也许我们应该花时间去理解和接受我们的真实本性，并在我们拥有的能量中找到价值，即使它没有达到我们认为我们想要的样子。在我真正倾听之前，我从未感到如此平静，我希望你遵循内心的真理，无论你是否是一个非常善于交际的人，并找到以你自己独特的方式给予和支持他人的方法
今天我在湖边发现了几片叶子、一些树皮和地衣，所以我把它们带回家仔细观察，在放大镜下研究它们，并业余尝试对它们进行分类并写下我的观察结果，这很有趣，我觉得即使我没有从事生命科学的职业，我仍然可以玩得很开心，真的很喜欢在一天结束时了解生活的这一方面，我的艺术敏感性接管并推动我进入

一个不同的方向，但我确实认为真正考虑那些未经历过的生活并找到将其融入日常生活的方法非常重要，我认为这使生活体验更加丰富，这是一个简短但希望甜蜜的视频，本周我发生了很多事情，所以出去到湖边，度过了安静的一天，创作艺术，所有这一切对我来说是如此特别，它激发了我重新审视友谊的主题，我很感动，最初惊讶于有多少人与该视频相关，并感受到了我的感受当我年轻的时候就感觉到了，这是一种非常非常感人的感觉，与人们交谈并打开它真是太可爱了

如果我不是一个超级社交的人，那么谈论拥有亲密的友谊意味着什么，这对我来说是有问题的。我也非常重视与非人类起源的事物的联系和友谊，我也重视在大自然中的时间，因为我发现这是一个真正自我反思的环境，在那里我可以成为我自己的朋友，我的生活和我的家人也有几个人离我很近，代表了志趣相投的重要纽带，我真的很重视那些人找到你真正联系的精神，我也是我感到非常非常幸运，我的丈夫也有这样的能力，并向你们所有人致以如此多的爱，感谢你们的善意和支持，我很快就会见到你们
